diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Weekday 9:00 AM"] --> HOLD["📋 Holdings first\nRobinhood positions (read-only)"]
  SCHED --> SCREEN["🔎 Dual-bucket screener\nMomentum + Value"]
  HOLD --> SCORE
  SCREEN --> SCORE["📊 Score 5 dimensions\nfundamental·technical·sentiment·macro·insider"]
  SCORE --> ANALYST["🎯 analyst_score (0-100)"]
  ANALYST --> LONGONLY{"Held vs new?"}
  LONGONLY -->|"Held"| SELLOK["SELL allowed on holdings"]
  LONGONLY -->|"New"| LONG["LONG-only, top 3/day"]
  SELLOK --> WRITE["💾 Write agent_signals"]
  LONG --> WRITE
  WRITE --> HANDOFF["➡️ signals ≥60 → PaperTrader"]

SCHED.label: Weekday 9:00 AM
SCHED.description: Runs pre-market every weekday via Windows Task Scheduler. Model is llama-3.3-70b on Groq (free tier) per agent_config — fast, zero cost for the scoring pass.
SCHED.addReason: Pre-market timing so signals are ready before open.
SCHED.changeReason: Model corrected to llama-3.3-70b (Groq); diagram was generic.

HOLD.label: Holdings first
HOLD.description: Pulls current Robinhood positions (read-only, account 965848641) BEFORE screening — highest priority so the agent can flag SELL on names you already own.
HOLD.addReason: Locked decision: holdings must be researched first; SELL signals allowed on owned positions.

SCREEN.label: Dual-bucket screener
SCREEN.description: Two buckets always run (no explicit regime switch): Momentum (RSI>60, price>50DMA, revenue accel) and Value (P/E<sector median, high FCF yield, insider buying). FinancialDatasets screen_stocks + Alpha Vantage technicals.
SCREEN.addReason: Regime adaptation emerges from scoring, not hardcoded bull/bear logic.

SCORE.label: Score 5 dimensions
SCORE.description: Each candidate scored on fundamental, technical, sentiment, macro, insider — combined by the current signal_weights into analyst_score.
SCORE.addReason: Multi-dimensional scoring is the core of the strategy.

ANALYST.label: analyst_score
ANALYST.description: The 0-100 composite. Weights are tuned over time by the LearnerAgent (via promoted challengers).

LONGONLY.label: Held vs new
LONGONLY.description: Long-only enforcement applies to NEW positions; exits (SELL) are allowed on existing holdings.
LONGONLY.addReason: Locked: SELL only on owned names; new = long-only.

SELLOK.label: SELL allowed
SELLOK.description: Owned names can receive a SELL signal when the score drops or direction flips.

LONG.label: LONG-only, top 3/day
LONG.description: New candidates are long-only, capped at the top 3 by analyst_score per day to avoid overtrading.
LONG.addReason: 3/day cap is a locked anti-overtrading rule.

WRITE.label: Write agent_signals
WRITE.description: Persists signals with direction, analyst_score, per-dimension scores, and rationale.
WRITE.addReason: Signals are the durable output other agents consume.

HANDOFF.label: Handoff to PaperTrader
HANDOFF.description: Signals scoring ≥60 become buy candidates for the PaperTrader flow.
